meta.title: New in Public Preview: PostgreSQL Support & TiDB Cloud Filesystem
meta.description: Announcing two powerful new features in public preview: native PostgreSQL support for flexible database compatibility and TiDB Cloud Filesystem for seamless cloud storage integration with your TiDB cluster.

props.headline:
PostgreSQL Support &
TiDB Cloud Filesystem
props.subheadline: Two groundbreaking features now available in public preview: native PostgreSQL compatibility and seamless cloud storage integration for your TiDB clusters.

props.title: Unlock New Possibilities

items.title: PostgreSQL Support
items.description:
Enable PostgreSQL protocol support in minutes through your TiDB Cloud console and connect using your preferred PostgreSQL client.
Run existing queries and applications while monitoring performance and compatibility from the console.

items.title: TiDB Cloud Filesystem
items.description:
Connect your S3-compatible storage to TiDB Cloud and query Parquet, CSV, and JSON files using standard SQL.
Seamlessly join cloud data with database tables and optimize query performance with filesystem-specific options.

props.subtitle: Both features are available now in public preview for all TiDB Cloud users
